claims.scope: Declared callable arity and authority transitions in the registered CallAuthorityTransitions model; compiler-resolved source controls and the exact finite CALL observation census. Parser and library-ledger authenticity beyond the extracted and observed boundary remain trusted, not universal Java refinement.

Occurrence-ledger allocation, consumption and nonreuse in the registered CALL transition model, with exact finite nested/repeated-call observations and source rejection controls. Unbounded Java allocation, integer overflow, resource limits and whole-parser refinement are excluded.

Exact ordered, nonflat, noncommutative, nonidempotent CALL policy at the registered transition boundary, with finite sequence and repeated-payload observations. No claim about arbitrary optimizer occurrence survival or whole-program equivalence.

Exact registry admission in the registered RegistryAdmission model, compiler-resolved issuance/acceptance controls and a fixed finite observation census binding the modeled registry fields. No new authority is issued by this package and full Java semantic refinement remains excluded.

Guarded arbitrary-chain reasoning in the registered GuardedJoinChain model, compiler-resolved producer/verifier guard controls and the fixed finite JOIN-chain census. Relation/type interpretation outside the model and finite correspondence boundary remains trusted; no unguarded reassociation claim.

excludedSurface: Original parent statements beyond the explicitly frozen repair scopes; no automatic ledger discharge
Whole-Java, whole-parser or whole-corpus refinement and arbitrary optimizer occurrence survival
New empirical results, production guarantees, rewrite authority or certificate authority
Unlisted claims, future input revisions and undeclared deployment environments
closureBoundary.interpretation: VERIFIED applies only to the five frozen finite surfaces under the declared TCB; not universal correctness or automatic discharge of broader parent claims.
trustedSurface: Lean 4.33.0 kernel; only propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice
Git deterministic commits in isolated frozen snapshots for TEST_ONLY certificate provenance, never workspace, release or experiment provenance
Pinned v2.13 engine, counted profile adapter, hashed area plugins and compiler extractors; tested, not Lean-verified
Hashed Alloy parser, source/type/registry interpretation and provenance decoding at the finite observation boundary
Python standard library, SHA-256, filesystem, OS and hardware
